training_data.name: allenai/tulu-3-sft-personas-instruction-following
training_data.quote: This dataset contains 29980 examples and is synthetically created to enhance model's capabilities to follow instructions precisely and to satisfy user constraints.

training_method.objective_quote: Recipe: JEPA-LLM SFT on medmcqa-hard + personas augmentation → GRPO on medmcqa-hard. JEPA-LLM objective, used as an auxiliary signal during SFT to bias toward stable, representation-level learning rather than pure next-token fitting. GRPO (group-relative PPO).

serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. The template is chat_template.jinja and includes tool-call and document prefixes. generation_config.json sets only bos, eos, and pad ids. config.json max_position_embeddings is 131072. tokenizer model_max_length is the overflow value 1e30, not a stated context. The card's 400 steps and batch size 64 are the JEPA-LLM SFT stage. GRPO uses batch 64/128 and 8 generations per item; its step count, learning rate, and epoch count are not stated. No mergekit_config.yml is in the repository (HTTP 404). The JEPA toolkit README can run LoRA or full fine-tuning; this card does not say which this run used.

evaluation_reported.text: EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness with Granite's chat template and batch size 8. MMLU 63.17 versus base 62.48. MMLU-Pro 33.06 versus 32.78. IFEval inst_level_loose_acc 85.97 versus 85.25, inst_level_strict_acc 84.05 versus 82.97, prompt_level_loose_acc 79.67 versus 78.74, prompt_level_strict_acc 77.45 versus 76.16.

discrepancies: Datasets and parent match. The card names SFT and GRPO. It glosses GRPO as group-relative PPO and tags the repo dpo-like. It does not describe a separate DPO stage or a separate PPO stage. The YAML tag dpo-like is not a statement that DPO was run.
